source_binding.I4C_primary: I4C_R2_FINAL_SCREENPLAY_R1 + sealed R2 mechanical/final hold receipts
source_binding.I4E_secondary_continuity_history: I4E_R1 sealed HOLD receipt only; used only to localize historical late-scene speaker-authorization debt, not as the primary R2 surface
source_binding.I4K5_primary: I4K4 sealed Control and Treatment whole-episode final surfaces that were evaluated by I4K5 independent judges + sealed I4K5 result/closure

scene_entry_explanatory_preface.candidate: first non-empty paragraph after scene header
scene_entry_explanatory_preface.normalize: collapse all whitespace to one ASCII space
scene_entry_explanatory_preface.classification_rule: candidate paragraph is explanatory preface only when at least two distinct marker regexes hit
scene_entry_explanatory_preface.preface_ratio: sum classified preface chars / sum normalized scene-body chars

sequence_purpose_copy.input: classified explanatory-preface paragraph of each scene; nonclassified scene contributes empty string
sequence_purpose_copy.common_prefix: longest character prefix shared by all five normalized prefaces, trimmed to final whitespace boundary
sequence_purpose_copy.episode_share: sum serialized_chars / sum normalized scene-body chars

continuity_measurement.rule: Do not infer continuity violations subjectively from prose. Use only already-sealed mechanical/semantic receipts.
continuity_measurement.I4E_R1_secondary: record sealed unauthorized-principal-speaker violations and their scene indices as historical continuity-debt localization evidence
continuity_measurement.primary_case_rule: R2/final primary surfaces use their own sealed critical-continuity/speaker-authorization counts

trend.robust_slope: Theil-Sen median pairwise slope vs scene index for per-scene preface chars, architecture-vocabulary density and meta-token hits

decision_guard: No new PASS/FAIL threshold is introduced. Output is diagnostic association only and cannot rewrite any sealed historical verdict or current R4A threshold.
